messages:
jamal_support: Escalating SageWell (org: 'sagewell-trial') 500s during onboarding ingest. Bulk import job stalled and now they9re seeing both failures and unexpected usage charges. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4120
tasha_cs: Thanks Jamal. Are they blocked from finishing activation or is it recoverable? Any security/customer data concerns?
jamal_support: Blocked for activation. No data loss reported but many retries pushed load and our rate limiter throttled them then produced client errors. SDK v2.4.2. Repro in us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
rebecca_csm: Ill lead customer comms. Proposed comms: immediate ack + short-term mitigation + billing pause request + bridge with SRE. Recommend 12pm PT touchpoint.
owen_eng: Quick triage: router-service misapplied a config toggle (tenant cap enforcement disabled for some tenants after deploy). Hotfix ready: re-enable per-tenant caps + add safe-queueing. Canary ETA 30m, full roll 90m if green.
ci_bot: Canary started: job 110987 for router-service-canary. Dashboard: https://ci.redwood.com/110987
tasha_cs: Draft comm to PM: 1) Acknowledge and apology (now) 2) Immediate workaround: run import with concurrency=6 OR use the resumable batch upload tool (link) 3) We9ve requested temporary billing hold while we investigate (pending Finance) 4) 12pm PT bridge with eng + hourly updates until resolved 5) If >6h, offer onboarding credit and priority assist from onboarding team.
rebecca_csm: Sending ack and scheduling 12pm PT. Adding note to renewal-risk tracker: set to ELEVATED if not resolved within 24h. Also offering to temporarily assign an onboarding specialist to speed the process.
owen_eng: Ops snippet for their SREs to reduce parallelism:
```
# reduce concurrency when calling import API
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/import
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"source":"s3://bucket/path","concurrency":6}'
```
Alternative: include header `X-Client-SoftThrottle: true` to enable server-side queueing.
jamal_support: Ive updated the ticket with the workaround, added monitoring alerts for router.429.rate and tenant.throttle.errors. Will block auto-retries from the SDK on their behalf until we9re green.
tasha_cs: Finance looped in for billing hold. Rebecca, please send the customer note and let me know if they accept the temporary onboarding specialist. Im prepping an internal comm (CS leadership + AE).
rebecca_csm: Acked. Sending now. If canary fails, escalate to Dedicated on-call for short-term reserved capacity for their ingest window.
jamal_support: Will keep thread updated hourly. Goal: error rate <1% sustained before we clear. :white_check_mark:
